title: Enforce temporal, source-group and identity leakage gates
summary: Extend the existing identity-context eligibility and label firewall to procedural, institution, roster and longitudinal feature evidence. Strict historical replay must reflect source and identity-link availability; retrospective smoothing and unknown chronology remain explicitly separate.
out_of_scope: Assuming an old media date proves historical availability
Treating exact file hashes as complete re-encode detection
Using ground truth or later machine corrections to build candidate/profile packets
implementation: Reuse current source/provenance/equivalence maps and exclusions; build connected groups before person/feature filtering so aliases through unenrolled recordings remain excluded.
Require strict-historical cutoff witnesses for query evidence, acoustic candidates, enrollments, profiles and any person-conditioned evidence links; unknown chronology refuses that mode.
Add profile-training membership and procedural/agenda lookahead checks, including later recognition, future chair role, final minutes and corrected source labels.

Keep original transcripts/upstream results private and allow only explicitly approved neutral fields into each condition; detect sentinel labels in titles, names, filenames and source-derived summaries.
Create adversarial fixtures and production-caller mutation tests for each gate; report exclusions and effective coverage without upgrading empty retrieval to evidence of absence.

acceptance.criterion: All known query/hearing/provenance aliases are excluded before top-K or candidate conditioning.
acceptance.verification: Use a transitive alias bridge through an unenrolled recording plus re-encoded-equivalence metadata; compare eligible/ranked lists.

acceptance.criterion: Future or unknown evidence/identity-link availability cannot enter strict historical packets.
acceptance.verification: Run independent clock perturbations on source, enrollment and person association and assert named refusal/exclusion.

acceptance.criterion: Gold identities and upstream machine names are absent from blind build/inference views.
acceptance.verification: Inject sentinels into reviewer labels, result files, original transcript metadata and derived summaries; scan actual packet bytes.

acceptance.criterion: Causal and retrospective modes record distinct permitted context and cannot be mislabeled.
acceptance.verification: Run a later-turn disambiguation case under zero and bounded lookahead; verify manifest/report mode and available input differences.

tests: Same hearing in candidate history under a different recording ID
Identity link verified after query cutoff
Late minutes reveal a previously unknown name
Roster filename embeds a gold identity
Candidate-less or chronology-unknown query still accounted for
risks: A package can validate structurally while retaining identity-bearing source text.
Unknown provenance and availability may require a smaller evaluable corpus rather than invented certainty.

reuse.application: Reuse strict historical versus retrospective modes and independent identity-link clocks.
Extend existing eligibility-before-ranking and build/report label firewall.

sources: User clarification, 2026-10-08, active Matter build: DIAT owns meeting learning; roughly 315 hours/5–10 recurring people is user-reported; crawler owns jurisdiction knowledge; private exported-data experiments only.
Original repository inputs: matterbrainstormspec; matterjevmesh; jevinmatter (brainstorming, not implementation evidence).
